title: Chemical heredity without genetic templates
summary: Acquisition and retention of catalytic function are established for a four-compartment chemical model with three prescribed catalyst types and finite resources. Starting with at least 512 copies of each of two old catalyst types per compartment, arbitrary candidate counts and arbitrary fuel occupancy, a seeding phase ends at time 30. At the fixed beta = 4,000,000 operating point, the joint mission through time 60 has failure probability at most 0.004517975690072193.
